techStack: Test runner: Vitest 4.1.5 with supertest; run via 'vitest run'
tsx 4.22.4 for TypeScript execution in dev
features: Current valid sort options: price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc — 'rating_desc' is in the SortOption type but absent from VALID_SORT_OPTIONS array in queryParser.ts (TODO comment present)
Current filter chain in productService.ts: search → category → inStock — 'featured' filter is absent with a TODO comment at line 23
featured?: boolean already exists on Product interface and ProductQuery interface in types/product.ts — no type changes needed
Featured field already optional on Product objects in products.ts — currently no product has featured set
inStock boolean parsing (string 'true'/'false' → boolean) is the existing pattern to follow for featured parsing
architecture: Request flow: HTTP GET /products → productRoutes.ts → productController.ts → parseProductQuery() → getAllProducts() → productService.ts → fetchAllProducts() (data layer) → paginated response
Query parsing happens inside the controller (productController.ts) before the service is called
VALID_SORT_OPTIONS array in queryParser.ts is the whitelist; values not in the array are silently dropped (sort becomes undefined)
Service applies filters then sort then pagination (slice) — new featured filter must be inserted into the filter chain before sort
dataFetcher.ts provides fetchAllProducts() — no changes needed there
edgeCases: featured=true/false must be strict lowercase string match; featured=1, featured=TRUE, etc. → query.featured remains undefined → no filtering
featured absent from query string → query.featured is undefined → service must NOT apply the featured filter (existing tests expect all 15 products returned)
Products without a featured field must be treated as featured:false via (p.featured ?? false) — 11 products will omit the field
featured=true combined with category filter must return intersection (e.g. featured=true&category=electronics → 1 result, id=1)
Ties in rating (4.8, 4.5, 4.3, 4.1) exist but tests only require non-increasing order — stable sort is sufficient
All 15 products have explicit numeric ratings (3.8–4.9); no undefined/null rating values to guard against
Total product count must remain 15 — adding featured:true to 4 products does not add or remove products
rating_desc must not interfere with existing sort options (price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc)
